options.label: Travel-first
options.angle: Focus on travel connectivity and destination exploration.

apple.name: Openline: Travel eSIM Plans
apple.subtitle: Data plans for travelers
apple.promotional: Explore destinations and stay connected wherever your next trip takes you.
apple.description: Planning your next trip? Openline lets you browse destinations and explore available data plans before you ever leave home. Choose a plan duration that suits your itinerary, then get everything you need to set up your eSIM, whether you prefer scanning a QR code or entering details manually. Once you're travelling, monitor your remaining data and keep your connection on track. A compatible unlocked eSIM-capable phone is required. Availability depends on your destination and device, so check plan details before you travel.

options.label: Simple setup
options.angle: Emphasize straightforward steps for getting an eSIM installed.

apple.name: Openline: Easy eSIM Setup
apple.subtitle: Install eSIM profiles simply
apple.promotional: Get your travel eSIM set up with clear, straightforward steps from the start.
apple.description: Openline walks you through getting connected without the guesswork. Browse destinations, pick a plan duration that fits your trip, and follow clear setup instructions, scan a QR code or enter your details manually, whichever works for you. Your eSIM information is right there when you need it, and managing active or pending plans is simple from one place. A compatible unlocked eSIM-capable phone is required to use Openline. Availability depends on your destination and device, so always check plan details to confirm what's right for you.

options.label: Everyday control
options.angle: Highlight user control over data, profiles, and app settings.

apple.name: Openline: Control Your eSIM
apple.subtitle: Manage data and profiles
apple.promotional: Stay in control of your eSIMs, data, and app preferences all in one place.
apple.description: Openline puts you in charge of your connectivity day to day. Keep an eye on remaining data across your active plans, review anything pending, and make changes without digging through settings. Adjust your notification preferences and language to suit the way you use the app. When you're ready to add a new plan, browse destinations and available durations, then set up your eSIM by QR code or manual entry. A compatible unlocked eSIM-capable phone is required. Availability depends on your destination and device, check plan details for the full picture.
